title: Staging before production
problem: Production may receive an artifact never exercised in staging.
rationale: Required pre-production prerequisite. Merge may approve code before an artifact exists; it must report release checks Pending, not “production ready”.
applicability: Registered production deployment of a built artifact.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: approved pipeline deployment/test receipt for the **same artifact digest**, environment identity and config class, followed by required smoke/integration tests. A staging URL or `ENV=staging` string is insufficient.
target_check.limits: **D:** approved pipeline deployment/test receipt for the **same artifact digest**, environment identity and config class, followed by required smoke/integration tests. A staging URL or `ENV=staging` string is insufficient. **R:** representativeness/capacity assumptions.
target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Required pre-production prerequisite. Merge may approve code before an artifact exists; it must report release checks Pending, not “production ready”.

expected_evidence: **D:** approved pipeline deployment/test receipt for the **same artifact digest**, environment identity and config class, followed by required smoke/integration tests. A staging URL or `ENV=staging` string is insufficient. **R:** representativeness/capacity assumptions.
repair: Exercise the exact proposed artifact in the approved staging pipeline and retain environment-bound smoke/integration evidence. Missing prerequisites remain Unsupported/Error.

delivered_coverage.reason: DH-M1 supplies descriptor references only; guidance installation, runner and target check coverage are not delivered.
